items.title: Bill Huntington and Charlie Suhor Interview, 1992-04-06
items.q: Then I came back and he had alienated a lot of the musicians and I'd work with him occasionally.

ctx.x: So by that time, Charlie, I think you were out of town, weren't you?

I went, excuse me, I was in the army for a while while he was, right around that time when you started playing with Burton. Then I came back and he had alienated a lot of the musicians and I'd work with him occasionally. In fact, my paycheck was being held up by the state of Louisiana during the integration time and if that hadn't been for Joe Burton, giving me a few bucks a night would be terrible. When I was at his club I would not have had money to feed my family at that time. But yeah, I was out of town for…
He hired them and fuss at them.
